budget.$comment: PERFORMANCE_ACCEPTANCE semantic preflight and report validation join each row budget to its unique M1 guardrail by metricId and require equal unit, direction and threshold. completionScope.description: Preregistered local semantic operation measured by existing cause-named metrics. Sample identity joins original cause to selected operation/owned scope, not entry or worker job alone. One entry triggering two independent source operations contributes two; one coupled A/B operation contributes one. Source/consumer denominators retain exact entitled operations before physical discovery/queueing. Source completion does not wait for independent consumers; optional aggregate reporting creates no global terminal receipt.

No global immutable partition. Processor verification, growing authority/WAL and retries measured separately.

controlGrowthDimensions.$comment: Counts apply to the measured finite computation, excluding fixture setup. CONTROL-STATE-MULTICOMMIT-GROWTH uses A=1, covers all three step counts and strictly increasing independently audited distinct owned-obligation counts. $comment: Revision-15.12 selected processing kernel; schema validity is not execution, equivalence or trusted-query proof. Preserve the 53 schedules and nine named subcases with applicable EQ1-EQ8 variants. Distinguish external-entry epochs from one-invocation FIFO; use authenticated observation programs, ordered placements, vertex-simple cyclic routes and complete shared-gas feedback scope. Canonical source-local initialization plus FULL_HISTORY and separate fixed source/parent meters replace promoter-dependent origin and cold combined gas. After terminal managed gas or recognized semantic runtime failure, the next operation aligns the actual successful pin to the source before-view with ordinary update/lifecycle/gas effects, then interprets the exact source program; no failed-event replay, forged source receipt or skipped unattempted range. Include event-before-patch, eventless/net-zero, both-fail-then-detach and fixed-cut COMPLETED_WITH_FAILURES controls. Relevant Timeline membership is directed per-operation evidence separate from the configured trusted universe; no reverse-observer completeness barrier or same-provider creation reset. Host temporal/ready/reverse-wait indexes support bounded complete queries at million-document/thousands-active-per-user scale; required 1k/10k/100k reactions may take increasing time. Measurement samples join original cause to semantic operation/owned scope: one entry targeting two independent sources counts two, one coupled A/B operation counts one. Aggregate reporting is optional. Censored durations are lower bounds; unknown quantiles remain NOT_RUN/null unless determined, and lower bounds may prove FAIL but never false upper-bound PASS. Library constructors, host mechanics and semantic verifier remain implementation/conformance work, not further specification profiles. Same-origin work follows frozen pre-origin seed order. First touch adds readiness, not ownership. Charge the admission check locally before a returning edge; combine distinct current group meters only when their sum fits the identical frozen policy limit. Otherwise fail only the initiating current group with recognized semantic AtomicScopeGasAdmissionFailure, actual gas and a required-sum diagnostic. Stable seed-local event identities survive joining; no retroactive shared-meter replay. All lawfully consumed gaps, including composite external-policy outcomes, require exact original-kind/classification/policy and settlement evidence. Unknown exceptions, internal bugs, IO/timeout/cancellation never become consumed semantic outcomes; owning-library classification repair precedes acceptance. Failed initialization remains unusable. Host quotas pause without semantic failure or input skip. J/L witness variants cover these laws; general interruption of an endless valid import sequence and inherited cross-operation fuel are outside the first POC.
